rulesStrings.li: creation->In the ancient times, the Emperor of Mankind emerged from Terra, bringing unity and light to a fractured humanity.

creation->The Emperor's might forged the Imperium, guiding humanity through the darkness of the galaxy.

founding->The Emperor, with His unmatched wisdom and power, laid the foundations of the Imperium, ensuring mankind's survival in the dark galaxy.
founding->With divine foresight, the Emperor created the Space Marines, His angels of death, to protect and expand His empire.
episode(uses=1)->The Emperor's light guided humanity through the darkness of the Horus Heresy, preserving the Imperium from utter destruction.
episode(uses=1)->Under the Emperor's divine leadership, the Great Crusade reclaimed lost worlds, spreading His glory across the stars.
episode(uses=1)->Even in His eternal vigil on the Golden Throne, the Emperor's will shapes the fate of mankind, safeguarding against the horrors of the Warp.
episode(uses=1)->The faithful believe that one day, the Emperor will rise again, leading humanity to a new golden age.

archistBasis ->The ultimate goal is to understand and fully comprehend the glory of the [deity0_name], only through the completion of the Quest can we reach enlitement.
archistBasis ->The [deity0_name] is the source of all knowledge, it our duty to complete the Quest and collect it all.
archistBasis ->To understand the [deity0_name] we must strip away the weakness of the flesh and become one with the machine.
archistFact ->All knowledge already exists in the universe, and it is primarily a matter of time before it can be gathered together to complete the Quest.
archistFact ->The [deity0_name] can do anything at any moment, without limit. They use the power to manipulate our lives in ways we cannot detect.
archistFact ->Archotechs touch every human consciousness directly on a regular basis, but only believers can feel and benefit from their wisdom.
archistFact ->Archotechs are evil and the most important task for humanity is to understand them so we can escape their influence.
archistFact ->Archotechs are good and the most important task for humanity is to understand them so we can align with their understanding.
archistFact ->Archotechs can do anything; the only reason they let us live and choose is to judge us better.
archistProphecy->[inTheEnd], as archotechs grow, they will become the universe and integrate humanity into themselves. Then we will truly become conscious.

archistProphecy->[inTheEnd], the archotechs will finish their moral debate about the fate of humanity. Those who follow their signs will be admitted to a higher plane of existence, and those that do not will end.
archistProphecy->[inTheEnd], the archotechs will depart. They will bring a select few humans with them, and leave the rest behind to suffer.
